svg.text: Sub-Second Ingestion & Real-Time State Tracking on AWS | Scale-to-Zero Architecture
• Target of direct browser / API document uploads
• Secure IAM Role & Presigned URL Access
• Action: Parses S3 event records, extracts key
• Generates UUID4 job_id, registers job metadata
Restricted specifically to bucket & table ARNs
• Scale-to-Zero: Zero idle costs when no files uploaded
• Auto scales up to 1,000 concurrent executions
State tracking for client polling & Web Studio
Memory Size: 128 MB | Max Used: 83 MB
Pipeline Performance & Engineering Highlights (AWS Well-Architected Framework)
• Event Ingestion Latency: Sub-second response (214 ms - 257 ms) eliminating polling latency and CPU waste on EC2 instances.
• Security & Least Privilege: Lambda function operates under huylam-ocr-lambda-role with inline policies restricted to specific S3 and DynamoDB ARNs.
• FinOps Excellence: True Scale-to-Zero architecture costing 0.00 USD within AWS Free Tier limits (1,000,000 free calls / month).
Reliable, resilient event-driven decoupled architecture ensuring zero message loss during traffic surges.
FinOps Spend: $0.00 | Event Pipeline: S3 Event -> Lambda -> DynamoDB State | HUCE Internship Report 2026 | Lam Quang Huy
